warnings.message: The official representative wind resource is for Northwestern Arkansas and proves model execution only, not California project production.

The executed binary is SSC 303 from the pinned REopt.jl repository, while the separately pinned official fixture repository currently reports SSC 308 expectations. The v308 numeric expectation is retained as non-asserted context only.
